THANK YOU FOR THE LAUGH! Truly epic display of cognitive dissonance meeting linguistic ridicule. Congratulations on successfully conjuring imagined scenarios that don't exist—and responding to them with alarming confidence.

I must say, finding ancient wisdom lost for millennia is truly admirable—even if it wasn't actually lost. What amazing detective work discovering what elementary students learn in grade school! your brilliant contributions restoring fundamental facts discovered eons ago frankly rival ones presented on cereal boxes—the genuine treasure trove of profound discoveries hidden among regularly billed magazines!
